subject: Rook now uses rApache's POST parsing

messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: Rook now uses rApache's POST parsing
parts:
Well, someone here at work just forced my hand on getting this feature out:

When running your Rook applications on rApache and you do file uploads  or send data via http POST, it's rApache's fast C parsing methods that get called and not Rooks Mutlipart$parse method.

I know some of you have been on the fence about hosting Rook apps on rApache exactly because of this, so now's your chance!

Expect a new version of Rook on cran within the next few weeks, but if you can't wait that long, you can get it here:

https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/Rook

or with devtools from R:

install_github('Rook','jefffreyhorner')

Jeff
